focus: Section 3.5, positional encoding. Show how sinusoidal positional encodings assign each position a vector of sines and cosines with geometrically increasing wavelengths. Let the learner change the model dimension and the position, and visualize the encoding matrix and individual dimensions. Check that every value lies in [-1, 1] and that dimension pairs (2i, 2i+1) use sine and cosine of the same frequency.
